caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate glass and metal pitcher with a round, textured body and a wide, short neck. The pitcher has a silver or pewter-colored hinged lid and an intricately designed handle, which appears to be made of metal. The glass portion of the pitcher is clear with starburst and diamond cut patterns in relief, which dominate its bulbous sides. The metallic neckband is decorated with a repeating swirl motif. At the top left corner of the page, there is a small inset drawing showing a simple, circular object with a short stem, possibly the top view or a component detail of the main pitcher, rendered in black outline. The artwork is bordered with a double-lined margin, and the artist’s signature, "T.A. Holloway," is located in the lower right outside the inner border. The background of the page is a plain, light beige color.
title: Syrup Pitcher
